title_zh: 代码怎么变成真实动作
description_en: This module is not trying to make you write code immediately. It first trains you to read what an AI coding agent is doing: what is still text, what actually ran, where it ran, what the output proves, and where risk may have entered.
description_zh: 这个模块不是一上来就让你写代码，而是先训练你看懂 AI coding agent 到底做到了哪一步：哪些还只是文字，哪些真的运行过，在哪里运行，输出证明了什么，风险可能从哪里进入。
capability_en: You can read a short AI coding-agent transcript and judge what was written, what ran, where it ran, what failed, what the output proves, and whether files or data may already have been affected.
capability_zh: 你能读一小段 AI coding agent 的工作记录，并判断：它写了什么、运行了什么、在哪里运行、哪里失败、输出证明了什么，以及文件或数据是否可能已经被影响。

customization_points.default_profile: Learner uses AI coding agents and has data-work context.
customization_points.rewrite_when: For a learner without AI-agent exposure, replace with spreadsheet automation, no-code tooling, or app-support examples while preserving the text -> command -> output -> risk chain.
For a learner without data background, swap SQL/table anchors for documents, photos, forms, or inbox workflows.
